title: Callbacks are reactions
description: Let incoming scans update node state, then use a timer to publish a status message. Sensor events and timer events are separate callbacks.
steps: Store the most recent forward distance when a scan arrives.
Use a 0.2-second timer to publish that distance as String on /chatter. Subscribe to /chatter and print each message.
Observe topic hz /scan and topic echo /chatter in separate terminals. Explain which callback updates the state and which publishes it.
hints: Keep a variable or self.front between callbacks.
A timer runs periodically; a subscription runs on message arrival.
Create publishers and subscriptions once, then let rclpy.spin dispatch events.
starterCode:
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from sensor_msgs.msg import LaserScan
from std_msgs.msg import String

rclpy.init()
node = Node('student_controller')

front = 0.0
# TODO: scan callback updates front
# TODO: timer publishes front as String on /chatter
# TODO: subscriber prints /chatter messages
rclpy.spin(node)
